hypothesis: BroadcomのFY2027支払予定purchase commitments 52.674B USDは、Q4 FY2026 AI semiconductor revenue run-rateのgross-profit/cash-generation capacityで十分に吸収でき、過大なinventory pre-commitmentではない。
why_it_matters: purchase commitmentsをgross exposureだけで評価するとBroadcomのAI成長投資を過度に罰する一方、利益・現金創出力で吸収できなければ将来のinventory/capacity downsideを過小評価する。

precommit_rule.use: 保守的なGAAP gross-margin proxyとFCF-margin proxyの双方でFY2027 commitments coverageが1.0x以上、かつgross-profit coverageが1.10x以上。
precommit_rule.condition: gross-profit proxyは1.0x以上だがcash-generation proxyは1.0x未満、またはAI固有marginが非開示でproxy依存が残る。
precommit_rule.unverified: purchase commitments、Q4 AI guidance、marginまたはperiod identityの一次情報が不足する。

broadcom_q3_fy2026_results.source: Broadcom Inc. Q3 FY2026 results published 2026-09-02

broadcom_q3_fy2026_10q.source: Broadcom Inc. Form 10-Q filed 2026-09-10, period ended 2026-08-02
broadcom_q3_fy2026_10q.purchase_commitment_scope: Unconditional enforceable and legally binding purchase commitments, primarily inventory; agreements cancelable without penalty are excluded.

method.note: AI-specific gross margin and FCF margin are not disclosed. Consolidated Q3 margins are explicit sensitivity proxies, not estimates of AI segment margin.

validation.look_ahead: No FY2027 realized revenue or margin is assumed. Q4 FY2026 issuer guidance is annualized only as a transparent run-rate sensitivity.
validation.missing_data_policy: AI-specific gross margin, AI-specific FCF conversion, FY2027 AI revenue guidance and contract-to-purchase mapping are not inferred.

result.finding: FY2027 purchase commitments of 52.674B USD equal 60.68% of the annualized Q4 FY2026 AI semiconductor revenue run-rate. Applying Q3 consolidated GAAP gross margin yields 1.139x gross-profit coverage and non-GAAP gross margin yields 1.236x, but applying the observed Q3 consolidated FCF margin yields only 0.761x cash coverage. Because AI-specific margins and FY2027 revenue guidance are not disclosed, the commitments cannot yet be classified as fully economically covered.

risk_metrics.reason: This is point-in-time fundamental commitment-coverage research, not a realized trading strategy.

decision_rule: Do not apply a standalone valuation penalty to Broadcom's FY2027 purchase commitments while gross-profit coverage remains above 1.0x under the conservative GAAP consolidated-margin proxy. Do not classify the commitments as fully covered until AI-specific or semiconductor-specific cash economics, FY2027 revenue evidence, or matched contract coverage lifts cash-generation coverage to at least 1.0x. Re-evaluate if Q4/FY2027 AI run-rate weakens, gross margin falls below the 60.68% break-even level, or commitments increase materially.
limitations: Broadcom does not disclose AI-specific gross margin or AI-specific FCF margin.
Infrastructure software has structurally different margin economics, so consolidated gross margin can overstate semiconductor gross margin.
Annualizing one quarter of Q4 AI revenue guidance is a run-rate sensitivity, not FY2027 guidance.
Purchase-commitment payment timing is not matched one-to-one with AI customer contract cash collection.
next_hypothesis: Broadcomのsemiconductor solutions gross marginまたはAI accelerator economicsを一次情報から制約し、60.68%のbreak-even gross marginを下回る現実的なケースがあるかを検証する。
